questions.question: The manager said that she would 'evaluate the situation' before making any decisions.
options: She was going to evaluate the situation.
She had evaluated the situation already.
She would have evaluated the situation by then.
She is evaluating the situation now.
questions.answer: She would have evaluated the situation by then.

questions.question: The new employee was 'given a lot of responsibility' on her first day.
options: A lot of responsibility was given to the new employee.
Many tasks were assigned to the new employee.
The new employee had a lot of freedom to make decisions.
She was expected to work independently.
questions.answer: A lot of responsibility was given to the new employee.

questions.question: If I 'had studied harder', I would have passed the exam.
options: I had studied hard enough.
I study very little now.
I will pass the next exam easily.
I wish I had studied more.
questions.answer: I would have passed the exam.

questions.question: The company 'has been experiencing financial difficulties' for several months.
options: The company is now facing financial problems.
The company has been in financial trouble since last year.
Financial difficulties are common in this industry.
They have already recovered from their losses.
questions.answer: The company has been in financial trouble since last year.

questions.question: The teacher 'asked the students to work in pairs' for the group project.
options: The students were expected to work individually.
Pairs of students were formed randomly.
Some students worked alone, while others worked in groups.
Students usually work together on projects.
questions.answer: Pairs of students were formed randomly.

questions.question: The new policy 'will be implemented next month' to reduce energy consumption.
options: The policy has been in place for several months.
A new policy is being discussed now.
Energy consumption will increase soon.
It's essential to reduce energy consumption.
questions.answer: The policy has been in place for several months.

questions.question: The tourists 'were advised not to visit the area during peak season' due to safety concerns.
options: Visitors were warned about potential dangers.
Safety measures are being taken now.
They decided not to go anyway.
It's a beautiful place to visit.
questions.answer: Visitors were warned about potential dangers.

questions.question: The company 'has been trying to reduce its carbon footprint' for several years.
options: They have already achieved their goal.
Their efforts are not making a difference.
Reducing carbon emissions is essential now.
It's too expensive to implement changes.
questions.answer: Reducing carbon emissions is essential now.

questions.question: The manager 'said that the project would be completed by the end of the year' at the meeting.
options: The deadline was extended to next year.
The project has already been finished.
They will work on it part-time.
It's a challenging task.
questions.answer: The project has already been finished.

questions.question: If I 'were you', I would take the job offer.
options: I'm not qualified for that position.
I would have accepted it if I had been offered a better salary.
It's a great opportunity to gain experience.
The company is not very stable.
questions.answer: It's a great opportunity to gain experience.
